purpose: Read-only reinspection of archived second permission desktop XML, command/result and source hashes
command:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
base = Path('docs/development/evidence')
gradle = base / 'gradle'
receipt_path = gradle / 'second-library-desktop.log.result.json'
summary_path = gradle / 'second-library-desktop.summary.json'
inputs_path = gradle / 'second-library-desktop.inputs.json'
log_path = gradle / 'second-library-desktop.log'
receipt = json.loads(receipt_path.read_text())
summary = json.loads(summary_path.read_text())
inputs = json.loads(inputs_path.read_text())
assert receipt['exit_code'] == summary['exit_code'] == 1
assert summary['input_hashes_unchanged'] and not summary['changed_inputs']
log = log_path.read_text()
assert 'BUILD FAILED' in log
archived = {r['path']: r for r in summary['reports']}
reports = []
modules = {}
for path in sorted((gradle / 'second-library-desktop/reports/calf-permissions').rglob('TEST-*.xml')):
    xml = ET.parse(path).getroot()
    sha = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert sha == archived[str(path)]['sha256'], path
    module = 'calf-permissions/' + path.relative_to(gradle / 'second-library-desktop/reports/calf-permissions').parts[0]
    counts = {key: int(xml.get(key, '0')) for key in ('tests', 'failures', 'errors', 'skipped')}
    assert counts['tests'] == len(xml.findall('testcase'))
    assert counts['failures'] == counts['errors'] == counts['skipped'] == 0
    assert not any(xml.iter('failure')) and not any(xml.iter('error')) and not any(xml.iter('skipped'))
    for key, value in counts.items():
        assert int(archived[str(path)][key]) == value
    aggregate = modules.setdefault(module, dict(tests=0, failures=0, errors=0, skipped=0, reports=0))
    for key, value in counts.items():
        aggregate[key] += value
    aggregate['reports'] += 1
    reports.append(dict(path=str(path), sha256=sha, name=xml.get('name'), timestamp=xml.get('timestamp'), **counts,
                        test_cases=[case.get('name') for case in xml.findall('testcase')]))
for module, counts in modules.items():
    assert summary['modules'][module] == counts, module
    task = ':calf-permissions:calf-permissions-' + module.split('/')[1] + ':desktopTest'
    assert '> Task ' + task in log.splitlines(), task
assert len(modules) == 11 and len(reports) == 15
assert modules['calf-permissions/core']['tests'] == 24
assert sum(module['tests'] for module in modules.values()) == 72
permission_inputs = {p: sha for p, sha in inputs['files'].items() if p.startswith('calf-permissions/')}
assert len(permission_inputs) == 75
assert all(Path(p).is_file() and hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sha
           for p, sha in permission_inputs.items())
checkpoint_path = base / 'PERM-checkpoint.json'
held = json.loads(checkpoint_path.read_text())['source_sha256']
current = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
           for p in Path('calf-permissions').rglob('*.kt') if '/src/' in str(p)}
assert current == held and len(current) == 139
print(json.dumps(dict(
    reviewed_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    scope='PERM-001–017 and PERM-024; independently inspected permission desktop subset only',
    base_commit=summary['base_commit'], source_state=summary['source_state'],
    command=receipt['command'], started_utc=receipt['started_utc'], elapsed_seconds=receipt['elapsed_seconds'],
    overall_exit_code=receipt['exit_code'],
    overall_result='FAILED: navigation/UI test failures and geo/icons test-compilation failures; not a successful combined build',
    permission_result='72 desktop test cases passed; 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skipped in 15 XML reports',
    command_receipt=str(receipt_path), summary_evidence=str(summary_path), log_evidence=str(log_path),
    input_manifest=str(inputs_path),
    evidence_sha256={str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (receipt_path, summary_path, log_path, inputs_path)},
    root_reported_all_selected_inputs_unchanged_during_run=summary['input_hashes_unchanged'],
    root_selected_input_count=len(inputs['files']),
    independently_matched_permission_input_count=len(permission_inputs),
    permission_input_mismatches=[],
    source_hold_check=dict(checkpoint=str(checkpoint_path), kotlin_files=len(current), changed_files=[]),
    totals=dict(tests=72, failures=0, errors=0, skipped=0, reports=15), modules=modules, reports=reports,
    limitations=[
        'Linux desktop execution of common production policy/controllers/request owners and Compose-runtime tests, not native privacy prompts.',
        'Injected native/backend/timer adapters are test fixtures; they do not verify UIKit/CoreLocation/Bluetooth/local-network lifetimes or OS dialogs.',
        'No Android-host, ActivityResult/device, JS/Wasm/browser, Apple compile/link/runtime, or native ABI verification is provided by this desktop receipt.',
        'Uncommitted owner-held diagnostic snapshot, not immutable release evidence; all 18 finding resolution statuses remain implemented.'
    ]), indent=2))
result: 72 permission desktop cases passed in 15 XML; overall combined command exit 1; 75 permission inputs and 139 held Kotlin files matched. No Gradle execution performed by this validation.
